topic.title: Steam games on my handheld
topic.question: What could get my Steam games onto my handheld?
topic.context: The handheld plays a few ported games well, but most of the Steam library still only runs on the PC. Nothing is decided yet: this is about finding ideas, not choosing one.

hold.question: Where is this going, and what are its main goals?
What's the smallest version of this that would already be worth having?
What excites you most about playing your Steam games on the handheld?
If you imagine it as wild as you can, how does it go?
What could make this useless, or hurt and go badly?
What's a twist on this that nobody would expect?

sparks.text: Is the goal porting, or playing your whole library on the go?

sparks.line: Two to get you buzzing. Write whatever they set off.

sparks.text: Does the game have to run on the handheld at all?
What would you play if the battery never ran out?
Many games won't run on hardware this weak. What decides which ones will?

suggest.line: Four within reach, from what I looked up. Kill any that miss.
suggest.question: What's within reach?

ideas.text: Start with games that already have a Linux build: no port needed.
ideas.why: Each game's Steam store page lists the systems it runs on.

ideas.text: Check your library against a community list of games known to run, and start tonight.
ideas.why: Community compatibility sites collect players' reports, game by game.

ideas.text: Games with Steam Cloud already carry their saves between devices, so the handheld can pick up mid-game.
ideas.why: A game's Steam store page says whether it supports Steam Cloud.

ideas.text: Begin with older and 2D games; they ask far less of the hardware.

suggest.line: Here's how it could feel more like yours.

ideas.text: Pick up exactly where you left off on the PC, mid-level.
A shelf of game covers instead of a list.
A weekly pick: one game you forgot you own.

suggest.line: Ooh, let's go far with it.

ideas.text: Your whole library, every game, streamed or ported, one tap away.
Ports that tune themselves to the battery left.

suggest.line: A few ways to stay out of trouble.

ideas.text: Skip games whose anti-cheat doesn't support Linux; their online modes won't run.
Port only what you'll actually play this month.
Port the save, not the game: carry your progress into a lighter version.
A shared list other handheld owners add their ports to.

suggest.line: Two other paths to the same place.

ideas.text: Don't port at all: stream from the PC and spend the effort on the controls.
Buy the few games you play most again, where the handheld's store has them.

recap.line: That's round 1. Send it back, and round 2 brings the council.
